sections.title: Biochemistry Laboratory
sections.description: Students carry out mentored research broadly relevant to biomolecular science within the groups of individual faculty investigators on or near the Penn campus. Students commit a minimum of 15 hours/week to original research in their host laboratories. In addition to research and assignments, students meet to present and discuss scientific research. Course activities and assignments complement the research effort. Developing effective scientific presentations is an emphasis. Each student must contact the course instructor with information regarding research group (faculty principal investigator) in the spring term prior the fall term of BCHE 4597A. BCHE 4597A and BCHE 4597B is a year-long, 2 cu course required of the Biochemistry major. The course is taken in a Biochemistry major's final year as an undergraduate.
